# Ecocee — AI Agents & Edge Computing | Kerala, India
> Ecocee is a Kerala-based technology company that builds custom AI agents, private AI infrastructure, and embedded hardware systems for businesses across India.

## What We Build
- **Custom AI Agents**: Trained on your business data. Automate workflows, customer inquiries, inventory, and operations. Deployed on-premise — no public cloud.
- **Private AI Infrastructure**: NVIDIA-based local AI servers. Your data never leaves your facility. No vendor lock-in, full data sovereignty.
- **Embedded Systems & IoT**: Custom firmware, ESP32/ARM hardware, PCB prototyping, IoT sensor networks for real-time operational data.

## Who We Serve
- Manufacturing and warehouse businesses in Kerala
- Retail and hospitality businesses needing 24/7 automated operations
- Educational institutions needing AI knowledge management
- Any business handling sensitive data requiring on-premise AI

## Real Projects
- **Ordato**: AI-powered restaurant order management and guest experience system
- **Adara Screens**: Digital signage with AI content optimization
- **Rallybox**: Motorsport telemetry AI with custom edge hardware

## Operating Flow
1. Discovery & Assessment — Map workflows before writing code
2. Solution & Architecture — Custom design, transparent Statement of Work
3. Engineering & MVP — Iterative build with client demonstrations
4. UAT & Deployment — On-premise with zero data leakage guarantee
5. Handover & Partnership — Full docs, SLA support, long-term partnership
